name: Laya AI Notification Command Center
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed local-first desktop notification aggregator and AI action-staging app. Free software for Windows, macOS and Linux, with local n8n workflows, event cards and integrations for Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Jira, Outlook and calendars; local Ollama or LM Studio inference can be used without a hosted Laya subscription or vendor-imposed software usage quota.
watch_out: No free hosted AI inference or provider API credits are included. Cloud model usage and third-party integrations can incur separate costs or quotas; local LLMs require your own CPU/GPU and disk. User must configure service connections and protect OAuth/API credentials; external actions are staged for approval. Software is a local desktop app, not a free hosted email delivery or VPS service.
